observations: Photo 0 shows a bare car engine/engine assembly on the ground (no car body attached).
There is visible wiring/hoses and an intake/airbox-like component on top, plus multiple hoses and connectors around the engine bay.
No clear readable brand/model markings are visible in the photo.
No close-up of engine serial/VIN/engine code plate is visible.
No visible damage assessment is possible beyond general wear/dirt; key parts (starter, alternator, turbo/supercharger if any) are not clearly identifiable.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show any import/tokumbo proof (documents, markings, or clear identifying labels).

risks.risk: Exact engine make/model (and therefore compatibility and market value) is not readable from the photo.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/serial plate (or stamped code on the engine block) plus a photo of the full engine label area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case for an unknown used engine: treated as non-verified/possibly incomplete and priced accordingly (no premium for brand/model).

risks.risk: Engine condition (running status, compression, internal wear) cannot be confirmed from a photo of a removed engine.
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine running (cold start if possible) OR a compression test report with readings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven to run (worst case: needs overhaul/repairs).

risks.risk: Completeness: missing parts (ECU, sensors, alternator/starter, turbo, injectors, wiring harness sections) cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Photo checklist: show ECU, starter, alternator, all sensors/connectors, fuel rail/injectors (if applicable), and the full wiring harness; also show what is included in the package.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly incomplete (worst case: buyer may need to source missing components).

risks.risk: Damage/leaks (cracks, bent components, oil/coolant leaks) are not verifiable from this single wide shot.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of common failure points (oil pan, cylinder head area, timing cover area, coolant hoses/ports) and underside; plus leak test evidence if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged/needs inspection (no assumption of good condition).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of engine code/serial plate (engine block stamping) and any visible brand/model markings.
Video of the engine running (or compression test results).
Photos showing all included components (ECU, starter, alternator, sensors, injectors/fuel system parts, wiring harness) and confirmation of completeness.
Close-ups of underside and suspected leak/damage areas (oil pan, head/timing area, coolant ports).
response.reason: The photo shows an engine assembly, but the make/model and running/condition/completeness cannot be verified remotely. Without the engine code and proof it runs (or compression results), a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
